title: When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.36308v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory-agent benchmarks often collapse retrieval and answer generation into one score, making it hard to tell whether a failure comes from missing an update or from not using an update that was already retrieved. We examine this distinction on the single-hop FactConsolidation task of MemoryAgentBench. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on 6K-history BM25 accuracy drops from 45% to 32% when the retrieved evidence budget grows from 64 to 512 tokens, even though a gold-assisted post-hoc audit finds the newest statement in every retrieved set. Most of the errors occur on questions that also contain an obsolete statement version. translated_title: 当检索还不够：智能体记忆中的过时事实
translated_abstract: 记忆智能体基准测试通常将检索与答案生成合并为单一分数，因此难以判断失败究竟源于错失更新，还是源于未能使用已经检索到的更新。我们在 MemoryAgentBench 的单跳 FactConsolidation 任务上考察了这一区别。使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在 6K 长度历史上，当检索证据预算从 64 增加到 512 个 token 时，BM25 的准确率从 45% 降至 32%——即便借助标准答案进行的事后审计发现每个检索集合中都包含最新陈述。大多数错误出现在同时含有过时陈述版本的问题上。在固定提示词和相同的四条陈述证据规模下，用过时的竞争陈述替换一条无关陈述，会使 Qwen2.5 的准确率从 100% 降至 44.6%，Qwen3-14B 从 100% 降至 87.8%，且全部 50 个有害的配对翻转均被归类为过时所致。在 32K 历史上的复现实验同样显示 BM25-64 优于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示智能体记忆系统的失败主要并非源于检索缺失，而是源于无法应对过时事实——即使最新信息已被成功检索，一条过时的竞争性陈述仍会使模型准确率大幅下降（Qwen2.5 从 100% 跌至 44.6%）。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that agent memory failures stem not from missed retrieval but from obsolete facts—even when the newest statement is successfully retrieved, a competing stale statement dramatically slashes accuracy (e.g., Qwen2.5 drops from 100% to 44.6%).
